title: 1613 handle corrupted sqlite
body: Filter the loaded list of wargames, to skip any corrupt ones

issues.title: Handle corrupted SQLite files
issues.body:
some SQLite databases have been corrupted.  An example of this is `wargame-koiquada.sqlite`.  When it is opened in `DB Browser for SQLite` it contains just one table: `sqlite_sequence`.

This table is empty. The other 6 tables used by PouchDb are missing.  But. the database file still has a substantial size: 212Kb.  That is larger than other substantial databases, such as `wargame-kzod28lc.sqlite`.

Ian will try and mangle a database so it looks like the pattern we're seeing.  If we can't spot the trend, hopefully we can robustly handle the situation when it arises.
